units.rawText: De Lacey has told me about your situation, Professor. I never imagined how much you'd been through before we met... It must've been difficult for you.
units.displayText: De Lacey has told me about your situation, Professor. I never imagined how much you'd been through before we met... It must've been difficult for you.

spans.text: De Lacey has told me about your situation, Professor. I never imagined how much you'd been through before we met... It must've been difficult for you.

units.rawText: I'm not sure how much I could help you, but our first meeting was when De Lacey brought me to the Oasis... and went through a terrible neural cloud evaluation.
units.displayText: I'm not sure how much I could help you, but our first meeting was when De Lacey brought me to the Oasis... and went through a terrible neural cloud evaluation.

spans.text: I'm not sure how much I could help you, but our first meeting was when De Lacey brought me to the Oasis... and went through a terrible neural cloud evaluation.

units.rawText: Yep, I still remember that. After that, Undine settled in the Oasis with Tranquillo and the others.
units.displayText: Yep, I still remember that. After that, Undine settled in the Oasis with Tranquillo and the others.

spans.text: Yep, I still remember that. After that, Undine settled in the Oasis with Tranquillo and the others.

units.rawText: ...Then you guys became the most hard-working part-time workers at the Oasis.
units.displayText: ...Then you guys became the most hard-working part-time workers at the Oasis.

spans.text: ...Then you guys became the most hard-working part-time workers at the Oasis.

units.rawText: Dididi, beeeeeep—(Work, make money, feed ourselves.)
units.displayText: Dididi, beeeeeep—(Work, make money, feed ourselves.)

spans.text: Dididi, beeeeeep—(Work, make money, feed ourselves.)

units.rawText: Honor must be earned through our own efforts, that's our base logic. Sadly, we're too weak to do anything beyond backline support for most situations.
units.displayText: Honor must be earned through our own efforts, that's our base logic. Sadly, we're too weak to do anything beyond backline support for most situations.

spans.text: Honor must be earned through our own efforts, that's our base logic. Sadly, we're too weak to do anything beyond backline support for most situations.

units.rawText: But thanks to the support work, we found the position that perfectly suits us—cheer everyone up with music, and bring both comfort and courage.
units.displayText: But thanks to the support work, we found the position that perfectly suits us—cheer everyone up with music, and bring both comfort and courage.

spans.text: But thanks to the support work, we found the position that perfectly suits us—cheer everyone up with music, and bring both comfort and courage.

units.rawText: Professor, thank you for giving us shelter and respecting our code of honor. There's just one thing I'd like to ask.
units.displayText: Professor, thank you for giving us shelter and respecting our code of honor. There's just one thing I'd like to ask.

spans.text: Professor, thank you for giving us shelter and respecting our code of honor. There's just one thing I'd like to ask.

units.rawText: About the piece to be played at ceremonies. We've performed at events and celebrations, but there's still one occasion we haven't covered yet...
units.displayText: About the piece to be played at ceremonies. We've performed at events and celebrations, but there's still one occasion we haven't covered yet...

spans.text: About the piece to be played at ceremonies. We've performed at events and celebrations, but there's still one occasion we haven't covered yet...

units.rawText: Professor, my dream is to perform in tribute to your triumphant return... Might I humbly ask for you to fulfill this wish?
units.displayText: Professor, my dream is to perform in tribute to your triumphant return... Might I humbly ask for you to fulfill this wish?

spans.text: Professor, my dream is to perform in tribute to your triumphant return... Might I humbly ask for you to fulfill this wish?

units.rawText: ...You have my permission. I'll entrust the piece to you when we return.
